text: This is not a good centre for injections on Westerners. I asked for a filer for my dark circles and I got it in my cheekbones instead (Asian fashion), which I didn't want at all. I hate the result of the injections they gave me by mistake. Worse, it worsened the blemish I wanted to erase in the first place (dark circle eye). When I told the doctor that it was under the eyes and not in the cheekbones, she didn't want to accept her mistake and told me that what I was asking for wasn't possible. This is a lie, because this type of injection, as I asked, is done very well in Europe and Latin America. What's more, the injection method is archaic and extremely painful. I'd never had an experience like it. What's more, the doctor never spoke to me to make sure that his assistants understood everything. A centre to be avoided by westerners. What's more, it's a centre that's the most commercial, ready to sell its most expensive products (reystilane) instead of advising customers like real beauty doctors. They didn't even offer a refund or a commercial gesture following their mistake. This clinic is to be avoided for injections.
I went to get a facial treatment and it was very good. The staff were lovely and gave very good advice.
I had a HIFU treatment here and was very impressed with the staff. Luckily, I got a promotion for 1,999 baht which included 400 shots.
I had a nose job done here and the staff were very attentive. I was very impressed! 😍😍😍 …
